newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber edges down on Palembang.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber edges down on Palembang.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices edged down in late trading on Friday after U.S. buying in Palembang, dealers said.

Dealers said February/March SIR20 offer prices edged down 00.25 cents/lb to 54.75-55.25 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 54.50-54.75 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang and to 54.00-54.50 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
One dealer said he sold March SIR20 at 53.75-54.00 cents/lb fob Palembang to some firms in the United States. Previous deals fob Palembang were done at 54.25 cents/lb, he said.
